result.topic_en: Mixed notes: a variational integral with a quadratic form ds^2 and averages of powers of direction components over the sphere, a pencilled spherical-trigonometry calculation, and a draft passage on the integrability (Riemann sums) of functions whose oscillations exceed a given size only on intervals of arbitrarily small total length, in connection with the representability of a function by a trigonometric series.
